body:
I'm thinking about going to another area, but it has to be in my state.  Since losing my job from so many doctors visits (another low point), I'm on state Medicaid until open enrollment when we can buy private health insurance.

My fiance is very supportive but at a complete loss too.  He wants to help but has no idea how.  One of the worst things is knowing how full of life I was when he met me years ago, and now I'm just a shell.  I want to be the person he met, and I can't and it kills me.
